applicabilityBasis.summary: Alto describes DUSD as the native dollar-denominated unit in isolated lending markets, created against collateral in Mint Markets and moved from supplied liquidity in Borrow Markets. DUSD can circulate beyond those markets and is accepted to exercise ALTO reward options. Terms disclaim any claim against a legal person and any role as payments processor, financial institution or creditor. Payment-style transferability coexists with protocol-internal credit use, and no fixed monetary-redemption obligation is evidenced. GENIUS applicability is therefore unclear.

genius.notes: Terms identify Alto Foundation as a Cayman foundation company and software brand, but expressly deny user claims against a legal entity. The software provider is not entered as issuerEntity without evidence of legal DUSD issuance or redemption obligations. Terms expressly state that the front end/software are not directed at EEA or UK persons and claim no MiCA/MiFID authorization or application; those statements do not establish a U.S. pathway. Protocol yield and foundation operating reports are distinct from token-level monthly reserve attestations. Alto's March 17, 2026 market report discusses GENIUS rulemaking generally; it does not announce a DUSD issuer application or pathway.
